354:t_009:18.en:
$$甲児$$
「That pink EVA over there is...」

354:t_009:21.en:
$$アスカ$$
「Four-Eyes! You're spreading pointless charm all over the place!」

354:t_009:22.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Talk later, $$アスカ$$! Bring $$シンジ$$, $$レイ#pt394$$ and $$マリ$$ and join us over here!」

354:t_009:23.en:
$$アスカ$$
「...Unit-02 and Unit-08 will follow your instructions. But I don't know anything about those other two...」

354:t_009:25.en:
$$カヲル$$
「Even in a situation like this, she doesn't seem able to let go of who she is...」

354:t_009:27.en:
$$シンジ$$
「$$カヲル$$... What should we do...」

354:t_009:28.en:
$$カヲル$$
「What do you want to do?」

354:t_009:30.en:
$n
「Quit dawdling, $$シンジ$$! Those guys are after the EVAs!」

354:t_009:31.en:
$$アルト$$
「Come to us! You're still part of $c!」

354:t_009:33.en:
$$カヲル$$
(People who accept you... $$シンジ$$... So this is where you belong...)

354:t_010:1.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Understood. I will deal with that artificial human and $c myself.」

354:t_011:0.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Supreme Commander $$ストラウス$$...」

354:t_013:0.en:
$$メール$$
「$$ストラウス$$ is leaving, Darling!」

354:t_013:2.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Looks like her $$欲深な金牛$$ $$スフィア$$ and your $$傷だらけの獅子$$ are a good match.」

354:t_013:3.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Compatible $$スフィア$$ resonate and boost each other's power, apparently.」

354:t_013:4.en:
$$ランド$$
「That uneasy feeling I got from $$ストラウス$$... Was that because of her $$スフィア$$ and mine...?」

354:t_014:0.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「They've thrown in all their forces...!」

354:t_014:1.en:
$$トロワ$$
「$$ストラウス$$ has pulled back. If we finish off the remaining forces, we win.」

354:t_014:4.en:
$$アスカ$$
「Don't act so familiar with me...」

354:t_014:6.en:
$$アスカ$$
「We're only teaming up for now... Don't get the wrong idea.」

354:t_014:9.en:
$$カヲル$$
「Let's go, $$シンジ$$. There's still something we have to do.」

354:t_014:11.en:
$$カヲル$$
「To keep hope alive, we have to get through this. Together with the people who like you.」

354:t_015:1.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Don't let your guard down! Something else is still coming!」

354:t_017:0.en:
$$フェルト$$
「I believe those are Empire forces that were left aboard the $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$.」

354:t_018:0.en:
$$デュオ$$
「That's a relief... Good thing they didn't blow up the facility when they bugged out.」

354:t_018:1.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「They must have understood how valuable $$ヴェーダ$$ is, too.」

354:t_018:2.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Still, there's no telling what kind of traps have been set.」

354:t_018:3.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「All units, enter the $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$ with caution. Then check each block.」

354:t_018:4.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「$$ティエリア$$, access $$ヴェーダ$$ and check the system, please.」

354:t_018:6.en:
$$アスカ$$
「...In the meantime, we'd like to talk among ourselves for a bit, if that's all right.」

354:t_018:7.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Okay. I imagine you'll want to confirm the situation, and think over what to do from here, too.」

354:t_018:8.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「You can use the briefing room on the $$トレミー$$. You're welcome to view any data you need.」

354:t_018:10.en:
$$カレン$$
「Looks like you picked up a little manners while I was away.」

354:t_018:12.en:
$$マリ$$
「Well... you can't stay a dreamy girl forever, kinda thing, ya know.」

354:t_018:15.en:
$$アスカ$$
「...Let's go, Brat $$シンジ$$. I'll decide about you guys there.」

354:t_019:0.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「D-Disgraceful...! To be bested by them in front of Supreme Commander $$ストラウス$$...!」

354:t_019:2.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Oh, your gracious words! $$ダバラーン・タウ$$ will hold them in his heart and swear to redeem this defeat!」

354:t_019:3.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Then I take my leave!」

354:t_020:1.en:
$$隼人$$
「He must be really devoted to that $$ストラウス$$ person.」

354:t_021:0.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「D-Disgraceful...! To be bested by them on a battlefield that Supreme Commander $$ストラウス$$ entrusted to me...!」

354:t_021:1.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「This blunder...! All I can do is beg forgiveness in the presence of Supreme Commander $$ストラウス$$ and swear to redeem myself!」

354:t_022:1.en:
$$隼人$$
「He must be really devoted to that $$ストラウス$$ person.」

354:t_023:0.en:
$$カヲル$$
(People who live with all their might, even while buffeted by fate...)

354:t_023:1.en:
$$カヲル$$
(I'm happy. I'm sure that you, of all people, will reach happiness someday...)

354:t_100:0.en:
$$刹那$$
「Recovering $$ヴェーダ$$ is the first step of our counterattack...!」

354:t_100:1.en:
$$刹那$$
「$$刹那・Ｆ・セイエイ$$...! Breaking through the enemy interception force!」

354:t_101:0.en:
$$ティエリア$$
(The data in the deepest part of $$ヴェーダ$$... $$イオリア・シュヘンベルグ$$'s true intentions...)
